import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def longest_palindromic_substring_precond (s : Array UInt8) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  s.size ≤ 1000000
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def palSliceBool (s : Array UInt8) (start len : Nat) : Bool :=
  (List.range len).all
    (fun i => decide (s.getD (start + i) 0 = s.getD (start + len - 1 - i) 0))

def candidateGood (s : Array UInt8) (p : Nat × Nat) : Bool :=
  decide (p.1 + p.2 ≤ s.size) && palSliceBool s p.1 p.2

def updateBest (s : Array UInt8) (best cand : Nat × Nat) : Nat × Nat :=
  if candidateGood s cand && decide (best.2 < cand.2) then cand else best

def searchList (s : Array UInt8) : List (Nat × Nat) → Nat × Nat → Nat × Nat
  | [], best => best
  | cand :: xs, best => searchList s xs (updateBest s best cand)

def allPairs (n : Nat) : List (Nat × Nat) :=
  List.flatMap
    (fun start => List.map (fun len => (start, len)) (List.range (n + 1)))
    (List.range (n + 1))
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def longest_palindromic_substring (s : Array UInt8)
    (_ : longest_palindromic_substring_precond s) :
    Nat × Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  searchList s (allPairs s.size) (0, 0)
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Helper definitions
def is_valid_subrange (s : Array UInt8) (start len : Nat) : Prop :=
  start + len ≤ s.size

-- A sequence slice s[start, start+len) is a palindrome if for all i < len,
-- s[start + i] == s[start + len - 1 - i]
def is_palindrome_slice (s : Array UInt8) (start len : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, i < len → s.getD (start + i) 0 = s.getD (start + len - 1 - i) 0

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def longest_palindromic_substring_postcond
    (s : Array UInt8) (result : Nat × Nat)
    (_ : longest_palindromic_substring_precond s) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  let (start, len) := result
  is_valid_subrange s start len ∧
  is_palindrome_slice s start len ∧
  (∀ i l, is_valid_subrange s i l → is_palindrome_slice s i l → l ≤ len)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem palSliceBool_true_iff
    (s : Array UInt8) (start len : Nat) :
    palSliceBool s start len = true ↔ is_palindrome_slice s start len := by
  unfold palSliceBool is_palindrome_slice
  constructor
  · intro h i hi
    have hi_mem : i ∈ List.range len := List.mem_range.mpr hi
    have hpred := (List.all_eq_true.mp h) i hi_mem
    simpa using hpred
  · intro h
    apply List.all_eq_true.mpr
    intro i hi_mem
    have hi : i < len := List.mem_range.mp hi_mem
    have heq := h i hi
    simpa [heq]

theorem candidateGood_true_iff
    (s : Array UInt8) (p : Nat × Nat) :
    candidateGood s p = true ↔
      is_valid_subrange s p.1 p.2 ∧ is_palindrome_slice s p.1 p.2 := by
  unfold candidateGood is_valid_subrange
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hvb : decide (p.1 + p.2 ≤ s.size) = true := by
      cases hv : decide (p.1 + p.2 ≤ s.size) <;>
        cases hp : palSliceBool s p.1 p.2 <;>
        simp [hv, hp] at h ⊢
    have hpb : palSliceBool s p.1 p.2 = true := by
      cases hv : decide (p.1 + p.2 ≤ s.size) <;>
        cases hp : palSliceBool s p.1 p.2 <;>
        simp [hv, hp] at h ⊢
    constructor
    · simpa using hvb
    · exact (palSliceBool_true_iff s p.1 p.2).mp hpb
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨hv, hp⟩
    have hvb : decide (p.1 + p.2 ≤ s.size) = true := by
      simpa using hv
    have hpb : palSliceBool s p.1 p.2 = true :=
      (palSliceBool_true_iff s p.1 p.2).mpr hp
    simp [hvb, hpb]

    (s : Array UInt8) (best cand : Nat × Nat)
    (hbest : is_valid_subrange s best.1 best.2 ∧
      is_palindrome_slice s best.1 best.2) :
    is_valid_subrange s (updateBest s best cand).1 (updateBest s best cand).2 ∧
      is_palindrome_slice s (updateBest s best cand).1
        (updateBest s best cand).2 := by
  by_cases hcg : candidateGood s cand = true
  · have hcand :
      is_valid_subrange s cand.1 cand.2 ∧
        is_palindrome_slice s cand.1 cand.2 :=
      (candidateGood_true_iff s cand).mp hcg
    by_cases hlt : best.2 < cand.2
    · simpa [updateBest, hcg, hlt] using hcand
    · simpa [updateBest, hcg, hlt] using hbest
  · simpa [updateBest, hcg] using hbest

    (s : Array UInt8) (best cand : Nat × Nat) :

  by_cases hcg : candidateGood s cand = true
  · by_cases hlt : best.2 < cand.2

      simpa [updateBest, hcg, hlt] using hle
    · simpa [updateBest, hcg, hlt]

    (s : Array UInt8) (best cand : Nat × Nat)

      is_palindrome_slice s cand.1 cand.2) :

  by_cases hlt : best.2 < cand.2
  · simpa [updateBest, hcg, hlt]
  · have hle : cand.2 ≤ best.2 := Nat.le_of_not_gt hlt
    simpa [updateBest, hcg, hlt] using hle

    ∀ xs best,
      is_valid_subrange s best.1 best.2 ∧
        is_palindrome_slice s best.1 best.2 →
      is_valid_subrange s (searchList s xs best).1
          (searchList s xs best).2 ∧
        is_palindrome_slice s (searchList s xs best).1
          (searchList s xs best).2 := by

  induction xs with
  | nil =>
      intro best hbest
      simpa [searchList] using hbest
  | cons a xs ih =>

      simpa [searchList] using

      is_valid_subrange s best.1 best.2 ∧
        is_palindrome_slice s best.1 best.2 →
